name: SWE-bench Verified
description: Gold standard evaluation benchmark for software engineering agents resolving real-world GitHub pull requests and issues in production repositories.

name: GAIA (General AI Assistants)
description: Rigorous benchmark testing multi-modal reasoning, web browsing, code execution, and multi-step tool use for autonomous assistants.

name: WebArena
description: Realistic and reproducible web environment benchmark for evaluating autonomous visual web agents across ecommerce, CMS, and coding tools.

name: HumanEval+
description: Standardized code synthesis benchmark testing Python docstring-to-code generation with rigorous unit test suites.

name: Needle In A Haystack (NIAH)
description: Evaluation measuring an LLM's retrieval accuracy across 128k to 2M+ token contexts by placing hidden facts at varied depths.

name: AgentBench
description: Multi-dimensional benchmark evaluating LLM-as-Agent capabilities across OS terminal navigation, database querying, web browsing, and digital games.

name: Swarm Concurrency & Task Throughput Benchmark
description: Measures task completion rate (tasks/min), 429 rate-limit avoidance, peak RAM consumption, and git conflict rate under concurrent loads of 10 to 100 parallel agent workers.
